Committee: Ways and Means General Fund
Sponsor: Clouse
Analyst: John Friedenreich
Date: 09/27/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 6 as introduced makes a supplemental appropriation from the State General Fund for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2022, in the following amounts to the following entities: (1) $135,000,000 to the Department of Corrections  Correctional Capital Improvement Fund to be used for the construction, renovation, and improvement of prison facilities, as provided by House Bill 4 of the 1st Extraordinary Session of the Legislature; and (2) $19,000,000 to the Bureau of Pardons and Parole to be used for the purpose of acquiring and renovating the existing prison facility in Perry County. Further, this bill reappropriates any unexpended funds for the fiscal year beginning October 1, 2022.
Steve Clouse, Chair
Ways and Means General Fund
